reviewer: Codex primary-source research with independent local data-contract review
review_method: Primary-source web text and official navigation review plus direct robots probes. This is original research metadata, not a retained manufacturing evidence packet. No complete visual table review or exact source-byte validation is claimed.

issuer_documents.locator: PDF page 30, printed page 27, manufacturing table immediately before Capacity and Utilization
issuer_documents.observed_scope: Twelve source-native fab rows, three annual capacity columns for 2023 through 2025, and separate company-total capacity, output and average-utilization rows.
issuer_documents.unit_review: The annual filing table reports thousands of 12-inch wafer equivalents. Native 6-inch and 8-inch fab figures must not be interpreted as native wafer counts.
issuer_documents.semantics_review: The table introduction calls per-fab capacity estimated annual full capacity. Actual output and utilization are company totals, not per-fab quantities. An installed-equipment, qualification or economically-usable basis is not established by this wording.

locators: PDF page 8, printed page 8, wafer shipments and utilization
PDF page 9, printed page 9, capacity tables and footnotes
issuer_documents.observed_scope: Twelve fab rows in adjacent annual and quarterly tables. Quarterly columns are 3Q26E, 2Q26, 1Q26 and 4Q25; the E marker is preserved as source guidance at publication.
issuer_documents.unit_review: Fab rows use thousands of native-diameter wafers; totals use 12-inch equivalents. This differs from the Form 20-F unit contract. Preserve publisher rounding and totals rather than requiring an exact sum using a rounded conversion coefficient.
issuer_documents.semantics_review: The footnote describes estimated capacity based on calculated maximum output, not design capacity, with equipment-delivery and ramp dependencies. Removing an E marker does not make later reported capacity an independently measured outcome. Company shipments are not the wafer-out numerator used by the utilization definition.

issuer_documents.review_status: Official navigation confirmed; complete table and footnotes not independently verified in this pass.

issuer_policy.robots_assessment: The wildcard user-agent disallows /upload/. This covers all three report paths and the linked terms PDF. No direct collector request for those documents was made. A permitted landing page does not authorize a disallowed linked payload.
issuer_policy.terms_review_method: Complete web-extracted two-page text reviewed before the robots decision; no local PDF retained.
issuer_policy.terms_assessment: UMC copyright is retained. The text restricts promotional use without written permission and warns that dated information may be superseded. No blanket redistribution, model-training or automated-archive license is inferred. The robots exclusion independently prevents this proposed direct acquisition.
issuer_policy.initial_probe_disclosure: An earlier direct robots read also showed the same rules, but its response was only tool-visible. The retained packet contains one later exact-byte probe, not every prior web or terminal observation.

distinct_statutory_filing_lead.discovery: SEC-hosted search result displays the manufacturing table. A full web open failed the research tool's content-length bound; neither result is an archived filing.

direct_policy_probe.assessment: The bounded direct probe printed an access-rejection page. This invocation did not retain HTTP metadata or raw response bytes, so no exact status, source-policy hash or cause of rejection is asserted. No filing request, changed user agent, alternate-host workaround or retry followed.

data_contract_findings.current_core_capacity_encoding: CapacityValue requires a non-null one-of-five basis and numeric low/base/high. It cannot truthfully encode an issuer maximum-output estimate with unresolved physical basis.
rejected_shortcuts: Relabel all issuer estimates as announced, tool_installed, qualified or economically_usable.
Allocate company output or utilization to each fab.
Divide shipments by capacity to invent utilization.
Use publication or retrieval time as the physical effective date.
Collapse annual and quarterly periods or native and equivalent wafer units into one claim series.
Treat Q1 forward guidance and a later reported estimate as an independently measured forecast/outcome pair.
data_contract_findings.recommended_followup: After admissible exact source acquisition, use numeric source-statement scalars with validated quantity metadata for metric, unit and scale, period, report vintage, numeric qualifier, source-native accounting scope and definition. Keep physical basis unresolved and exclude these observations from physical-capacity exports until separately supported. Each quantity series must include its full semantic dimensions; the core supersedes same-series null-effective-date claims.
data_contract_findings.full_denominator_gate: Any future importer must review every row and selected column of the complete bounded table, together with headers and footnotes. No numeric cell is admitted from this research record.

next_action: Resolve a permitted exact-byte acquisition for the statutory filing, or obtain issuer permission before accessing disallowed report paths. Then visually verify complete tables and admit source-native quantities with explicit semantics. Retained TSMC company-level quantities are separate evidence and cannot replace missing UMC fab evidence.
